note: multinom(y ~ x1 + x2) Newton-polished to the MLE. keys category-major: <level>:(intercept), <level>:x1, <level>:x2 per non-reference level in fitted order (categories: reference first, then the observed levels in dictionary order); vcov row-major over keys; fitted_probabilities row-major n x L over categories; score_probabilities / score_log_odds row-major (score rows) x L over categories, log-odds vs the reference; holdout = the weighted proper scores of holdout_rows [x1, x2, y(, w)] (a row at a dropped level scores nothing): log_loss = mean -ln P(y), brier = mean sum_k (P_k - [y = k])^2, accuracy = mean [first argmax = y] in dictionary order; robust = the closed-form score sandwich per type (hc0, hc1, cluster CR1 over clusters, one per row) in the keys' order; exponentiated = exp(b), exp(b) SE, exp(b -/+ z SE) in the keys' order (the case's, and each robust type's on its SE); term_tests = per predictor (x1, x2) the joint Wald chi2 on df = K non-reference levels (the classical V; each robust type's term_tests_wald on its own) and the LR chi2 against the polished refit without it (car::Anova(multinom), type II; absent under probability weights), upper-tail p-values.
